V5.3 DESCRIPTION -- FULL CATALOGUE, PRODUCTS WITH A FINDING
================================================================================================

2,619 of 11,069 products have at least one finding.
The other products are in exports/v5_3_full_scores.xlsx -- this file is
the flagged minority, because a 35 MB file of 11,069 products is not one
anybody opens.

VERIFIED BY SAMPLING (40 products each, seed 42):
  filled with no heading          ~90% are REAL gate leaks
  itinerary lines without signal  ~90% are REAL line-test failures
Both were checked because the equivalent flags on the booking run were
mostly the scorer's own fault. Here they are not -- every earlier sample
was heading-rich by selection, and the full catalogue is not.

NOT VERIFIED: duplication, untraceable, missing sentences. Treat those
counts as upper bounds.
